description: Image Description: The image is a triptych showcasing three sequential stages of using a Cuisinart SmartPower DuArt blender to make a smoothie. In the first panel on the left, the blender's clear pitcher contains chunks of red watermelon and yellow fruit (possibly pineapple or mango), ready for blending. The base of the blender is white with a control panel featuring several buttons labeled with functions such as "Pulse," "Chop," "Mix," "Blend," and others.
